scope: Complete retained original inputs used by build/source-validation producers. Reference-only rows do not imply emitted Windows features; canonical baseline stays v025.
nonBiliPaiInputNote: The three Coil source-artifact inputs keep their existing Gradle source/artifact pins. They are not queried as jay3-yy/BiliPai Git paths.
nonBiliPaiArchiveNote: Media3 PlaybackException.java retains the exact source-artifact SHA and URL in the pinned offline-error manifest. It is not a BiliPai Git file.
